verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only raw access to accounts, balances and transaction history (Data API) and account-holder name verification (Verification API). There is no documented feature that derives income or cash-flow signals, detects recurring streams or payroll, or provides an income verification product. Raw transaction access is only a building block a developer could use to construct such analysis, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform derives income and cash-flow signals from connected accounts — recurring streams, payroll detection, or documented income verification products built on the same data
